appliesTo: every mutating endpoint in scope, called directly (bypassing the UI)

checks.name: every input variant from inputs.json sent straight to the API
checks.expect: same validation result as the UI promises

checks.name: extra fields the client must not set (mass assignment): role, isAdmin, ownerId, userId of someone else, id, createdAt, archived, status flags
checks.expect: ignored or 400; the stored record does not take them

checks.name: wrong content type and malformed JSON
unexpected HTTP method on each path
ids that are negative, zero, non-numeric, or far out of range

pass: Server-side validation matches the documented rules and the DB never stores a field the client may not set.
fail: A stored privileged field, a 500, or data the UI would have rejected being accepted.
fix: Validate on the server with an allow-list of fields per endpoint; set ownership and roles from the authenticated user, never from the body; cap body size.
